limitations: Unknown financial values remain null; unknown is not a confirmed zero.
GA pagePath views are not landing-page sessions; current output lacks page-by-source joins.
GA source row sessions sum to 367 versus 364 overall; the difference is unexplained. Users can overlap across source rows. Do not force reconciliation or calculate channel shares/conversion rates.
Historical QA exclusion is not fully established. Never label all aggregate users as new external buyers.
GSC page/query detail is 90-day; do not relabel it as 30-day.
GA, GSC, affiliate records and payouts have different clocks and delays; do not combine unmatched windows into a funnel.

targets.definition: All-site GA sessions in the matched campaign period. Campaign-UTM-attributed sessions are a separate observation; do not label before/after differences as incremental causal impact. Report active users and QA exclusion coverage separately.
All-site existing affiliate_click events in the matched period, with verified QA exclusion. Campaign-specific attribution is a separate observation. Events are not unique referrals or customers.

New customer's actual paid purchase observed in supplier records; record purchase date and attribution. Separate signup/trial, pending commission, commission approval and payout. A paid purchase does not satisfy a 45/60-day commission waiting period by itself. Verify COSHUMA referral attribution separately from attribution to a particular campaign post; never infer the latter from dates alone.
Site-wide Google Search impressions during the aligned source period. Show the source window and last available date.
Site-wide Google Search clicks, not unique visitors or social clicks. Campaign causal uplift is not established by a before/after change.
Newly recorded campaign commission only, by currency and pending/approved status. Do not substitute customer gross payments, lifetime commission, recurring MRR or payout.

financial_plan.interpretation: Zero cash is the planning assumption, not an assertion that current revenue is zero. Overall net profit cannot be computed without actual costs and a complete revenue ledger.

sensitivity_only.limitations: Illustrative conditional arithmetic, not calibrated probabilities, a forecast range or a ceiling. Fractional expected customers are mathematical quantities. Refunds, disqualification, tax, existing costs and payout delay are not modelled.

decision_rules.rule: Check intent, offer fit and destination; make one supported narrow content/CTA change outside protected experiments and annotate it. Do not infer the cause from zero clicks alone.
Prioritize useful distribution and visibility. Record insufficient data; do not declare a product or channel successful or failed.
Verify attribution, amount/currency and commission state. Continue narrowly; one customer does not validate scaling or establish repeatable profit.

decision_rules.rule: Report failure to meet the paid goal. If fewer than 50 real affiliate clicks were obtained, distribution remains unvalidated; if 50+ clicks but no paid purchase, examine offer/intent/measurement before any further scale or spending.
